reason: the design fails 3 of its checks

findings.text:
RHYD-1: 1 part to fix
RHYD-1[code]: On resume, before the dispatch loop, completed-stage artifacts are rehydrated via _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back and placed in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR covers: RESU-1 RESU-2 RESU-4 HYDR-1
  Given: A run has been interrupted; stage k-1 is marked complete with its artifacts present in the git state branch; stage k was the interrupted stage
  When: The run is resumed via any of the three entry paths (--resume flag, auto-resume on status=interrupted, or zbuild pipeline resume --run-id)
  Then: _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back are called for each completed stage before the dispatch loop starts [FIX IN DESIGN: names two specific internal functions rather than stating what happens to the artifacts; the behavioral outcome ("byte-identical" artifacts in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR) is stated only in the And parts, not here — say what someone could see happen, not how it is built]
  And: The completed stage's artifacts appear in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR byte-identical to their state at the time of interruption
  And: No stage.start event is emitted for the completed stage

FSTG-1: 1 part to fix
FSTG-1[code]: --from-stage <s> rehydrates all stages before <s> and dispatches <s> as the first stage covers: FROM-1 FROM-2
  Given: A previous run completed stages before <s>; their artifacts are present in the git state branch; a new invocation uses --from-stage <s>
  When: The runner starts with --from-stage <s>
  Then: _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back are called for every stage before <s> [FIX IN DESIGN: names the same two internal functions instead of stating that prior-stage artifacts are restored; the behavioral outcome (artifacts in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR) is relegated to the And — say what someone could see happen, not how it is built]
  And: Those stages' artifacts appear in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR
  And: Stage <s> is dispatched as the first stage (a stage.start event is emitted for <s>)
  And: No stage.start event is emitted for any stage before <s>

ENTR-1: 1 part to fix
ENTR-1[code]: All three resume entry paths (--resume flag, auto-resume on status=interrupted, zbuild pipeline resume --run-id) invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before the dispatch loop covers: PATH-1
  Given: A run has been interrupted and its state is persisted in runs/<run_id>/
  When: The run is resumed via any of the three entry paths in turn
  Then: _runner_resume_rehydrate is called in each case before the dispatch loop runs [FIX IN DESIGN: the sole Then asserts only that a named function is called, not that any of the three entry paths produces the R1 behavioral outcome (artifacts restored, completed stages skipped, interrupted stage dispatched); PATH-1 says each path "behaves as R1" and that proof is entirely deferred to delegation — say what someone could see happen, not how it is built]

answers: design finding 1:** Fixed. FRSH-2's first `Then:` now says "Every stage emits a stage.start event and no stage.skip event is emitted for any stage" — an outcome a test can observe (by asserting on emitted events) rather than a description of which internal guard branch runs. The second `And:` ("Every stage is dispatched from stage 1 without consulting prior run state") is preserved as a complementary observable outcome.
